messages.author: 3bb114c28b2e3f7a
messages.subject: Interactive menus in shiny ui
parts:
I am wondering if there is a way to have a dynamic relation between one drop-down menu and another one. That is if I choose a selection from one menu the selections in the other menu would change accordingly. 
I tried a conditionalPanel but it does not seem to work. Here is what I have in my ui.R file:

Main_list <- list("Healthcare Practitioners and Technical Occupations"="Healthcare Practitioners and Technical Occupations",
                  "Healthcare Support Occupations"="Healthcare Support Occupations")

Pract_Tech_list <- Man_text("./BLS_HC_Prac_List_2012")
Supp_list       <- Man_text("./BLS_HC_Supp_List_2012")

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  
  headerPanel("Distribution of Healthcare Professions in the US"),
  
  sidebarPanel(
    selectInput("main", "Select a Health Care Occupation Profile:", Main_list),

    conditionalPanel(condition="input.main=='Healthcare Practitioners and Technical Occupations'",
                     selectInput("prof", "Select Profession:",
                                 Pract_Tech_list)),
    conditionalPanel(condition="input.main=='Healthcare Support Occupations'",
                     selectInput("prof", "Select Profession:",
                                 Supp_list)),
    
    selectInput("map_type", "Select Map Type",
                list("Per 1 Million residents" = "perMcapita", 
                     "Total Number" = "number")),
......

messages.author: 68ce5dd269fd758c
messages.subject: Re: Interactive menus in shiny ui
parts:
use renderUI. 

## server.R

output$menu1 <- renderUI({
  selectInput("m1", "Menu 1", c("a", "b"))
})

output£menu2 <- renderUI({
  if (!is.null(input$m1)) {
    if (input$m1 == "a") Choices <- c("home", "contact")
    if (input$m2 == "b") Choices <- c("This", "That")
   selectInput("m2", "Menu 2", Choices )
  }
})


## ui.R

uiOutput("menu1")
uiOutput("menu2")

parts:
good day,

I had a similar problem:

I have a selectinput named "typeCompetitor" that has as choices: "companysubgroup" and "companygroup"
I want to condition the choices in another selectinput named "company" on "typeCompetitor".

I have combined observe with "updateSelectInput" just like Antonio:

this works (hardcoded):
observe({
    if (input$typeCompetitor!="companysubgroup") {
      companyOptions <- levels(data[[1]]$full$companygroup)
    } else {
      companyOptions <- levels(data[[1]]$full$companysubgroup)
    }
    updateSelectInput(session, "company", choices=companyOptions)
})

I first tried with Joe's last option:
observe({
    companyOptions <-levels('$'(data[[1]]$full,input$typeCompetitor))
    updateSelectInput(session, "company", choices=companyOptions)
})

here I get an error: 
Error in data[[1]]$full$(input$typeCompetitor) : 
  invalid subscript type 'language'

strangely: what for Antonio did not work, for me did:
observe({
    companyOptions <-levels(eval(parse(text=paste0("data[[1]]$full$", input$typeCompetitor))))
    updateSelectInput(session, "company", choices=companyOptions)
})

Franco
